item.title: Last week’s Springfield restaurant health code violations, Feb. 23-27
item.description: Health code inspections of Springfield restaurants revealed a total of 28 priority violations and 26 nonpriority violations, while routine inspections of food establishments revealed 14 priority violations and 12 nonpriority violations, all of which were corrected on site.

item.title: Springfield man faces murder charge in fatal Friday night shooting
item.description: Cadeb Burks has been charged with second-degree murder, unlawful use of a weapon and two counts of armed criminal action for the shooting of 48-year-old Anthony Chambers on February 27th.

item.title: Support begins for displaced tenants after Springfield apartment fire
item.description: A massive fire ripped through 24 units at the Pebblecreek apartment complex in Springfield, Mo., causing three injuries and forcing dozens of tenants to find new homes, while the Red Cross and other organizations are providing assistance to those affected.
